svg.title: What we found
svg.desc: An audit of a real Mac on 2026-10-21 found the default profile's daemon running for 67 hours with 49 tabs open. Agents had opened every one of them by name for a task and never closed it. Together they held 17.4 GB across 47 WebKit processes and kept 90% of a CPU core busy. A tab closed only when its daemon exited, after 15 minutes without a command, and a Mac where agents work all day never gives it those 15 minutes. Every tab also kept running its animations and timers, because Umbra's pages always see themselves as visible.
